reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Orange Senegal now publishes Sama Numéro at XOF 3,000/6 months, XOF 5,000/12 months and XOF 10,000/24 months. Payment is available from airtime via #165#/#166# or Orange Money via #144#, and validity begins on subscription. The Teeru tourist SIM is currently XOF 9,900 with 30-day number validity and explicitly supports extension through Sama Numéro. Admission remains backstage only; roaming/OTP reliability is not inferred.

events.outcome: The previously unresolved fee is now explicit: XOF 3,000/6 months, XOF 5,000/12 months and XOF 10,000/24 months. Subscription is available via airtime USSD or Orange Money, and the extension starts on the subscription date.

data.acquisitionSummary: Sama Numéro is a retention add-on for eligible Orange/Kirène lines rather than a standalone SIM. Orange currently sells the Teeru tourist SIM/eSIM for XOF 9,900 with 30-day number validity and explicitly allows extension through Sama Numéro.

keep.action: Buy Sama Numéro validity: XOF 3,000/6 months, XOF 5,000/12 months or XOF 10,000/24 months. Pay from airtime via #165#/#166# or Orange Money via #144#. Validity starts on the subscription date.

data.chinaActivation: Initial line acquisition/registration is a Senegal-side process in current provider material. Sama Numéro is intended for customers who will be abroad for long periods after acquiring the line.
data.kyc: The Teeru tourist acquisition path requires identity/travel documentation; Sama Numéro preserves an already registered eligible line.
data.payment: Sama Numéro can be paid from telephone credit via #165#/#166# or Orange Money via #144#.
data.roamingSms: Sama Numéro preserves the number/account, but current evidence does not establish China-specific incoming SMS or OTP reliability.
data.tariffSummary: Sama Numéro: XOF 3,000/6mo, XOF 5,000/12mo, XOF 10,000/24mo; no regular recharge required during purchased validity.
guideSteps: Acquire and register an eligible Orange/Kirène line in Senegal.
Before a long absence, subscribe to Sama Numéro with airtime or Orange Money.
Choose 6, 12 or 24 months and track validity from the subscription date.
